pinnedFiles.reason: The feature spec. Settles the approach (keep default CRS, replace the OSM tile layer with an L.imageOverlay) and lists every acceptance criterion the analyst must turn into tasks.

The single file to change. Contains the OSM L.tileLayer call to remove, the markers/territory GeoJSON/popups/layer control that must keep their relative positions, and the window.__SATURDAY_LEAFLET_MAP__ exposure the fix must not disturb.

The suite that must pass unchanged. Fixes the real lat/lng values (center 45.0/-120.0, zoom-10 bounds, geolocation pan, 300-400km Turf distance) the imageOverlay's geographic bounds must still satisfy under the default CRS.

Defines waitForMapLoad (resolves immediately unless a layer exposes isLoading()) and checkTileFailures (queries .leaflet-tile elements for naturalWidth===0). An L.imageOverlay has neither an isLoading method nor a .leaflet-tile class, so the analyst needs this to confirm both fixture calls stay satisfied with no special-casing.

Holds the app's only existing 'no request leaves the app's own origin' Playwright pattern (collectOffOriginRequests, APP_ORIGIN_HOSTNAME/ALLOWED_PORTS). AC4's new blocking test should reuse or extend this mechanism rather than invent a second one.

Most recent prior delivery in this bounded context (ye-olde-magic-shop frontend) that removed an external-origin dependency. Its Out of Scope section explicitly names this feature ('leaflet-local-tiles') as the deferred map-tile half of the same problem, and its AC/task shape (exact-pin new assets, record failing-test evidence for negative cases, no-request test with no host exceptions) is the template this feature should follow. No retrospective.md exists for it, so no What-Went-Poorly/What-To-Improve content could be pulled.
App entry point; currently imports leaflet/dist/leaflet.css globally. Relevant if the fix needs any app-wide leaflet setup beyond LocationsView.vue itself.

Documents the public contract of the `leaflet` Playwright fixture (waitForMapLoad, checkTileFailures, getBounds, distanceBetween, etc.) that both map.spec.ts and the new AC4 test depend on — needed to know what the harness guarantees versus what the view must provide.
